title: Ben and Meg Get a Cod
lines: Dad and Ben and Meg got a big net.
"A big cod is in the bog," said Ben.
Dad set the net in the bog.
Ben and Meg did tug and tug.
The net got a cod and a bug!
"Do not get the bug," said Meg.
Ben did tip the bug in the mud.
Mom got a pot and fed Ben and Meg.

questions.ask: What came up in the net?
questions.listenFor: A cod and a bug. The story says both. If your child names only one, have them read that line again.

questions.ask: Who set the net in the bog?
questions.listenFor: Dad. Listen for Dad - Ben and Meg did the tugging, but Dad was the one at the water.

questions.ask: Why do you think Meg said not to get the bug? Tell me what you think.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine - a bug is not for the pot, or the bug was better off in the mud. You want a reason, not a right answer.
